messages:
Liam (AE): heads-up — Skylark POC demo cut off mid-answer (~10s) and browser threw JSON.parse error. customer says blocker for PO.

Priya (solutions): yikes. which model/env and are they behind a corporate gateway/proxy?

Liam (AE): hosted api, model=redwood-gen-small, stream=true. user on Chrome behind Skylark Gateway (corp). they can reproduce consistently through the gateway, bypass works.

Noor (eng): assigning. quick hypothesis: intermediate gateway is resetting or transforming the SSE connection -> truncated chunk -> parse error. also check for token refresh 401s.

Jacob (platform): infra shows a FIN from Skylark Gateway at 2025234590 and a proxied 502 logged by our edge at 2025234591. no global 429 spikes. auth service shows a token refresh error at 2025234588 for that session.

Liam (AE): client console they sent: 
```
EventSource opened
onmessage: data len=190
onmessage: data len=36 -> Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input
reconnect in 1s
fetch error: net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET
```

Noor (eng): please try this curl repro if they need a direct test: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=redwood-gen-small&stream=true"
```

Jacob (platform): suggested customer-side fixes: 1) ask Skylark admin to increase idle timeout to >=60s for SSE, 2) disable buffering/inspection for `Accept: text/event-stream`, 3) preserve `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` and `Connection: keep-alive`, 4) set `Cache-Control: no-transform`. if they use nginx: `X-Accel-Buffering: no`.

Noor (eng): short-term mitigations we can provide: server send SSE comment heartbeats every 810s and include `retry:1500`; SDK guidance to buffer partial chunks and attempt reassembly across reconnects. small pseudo: 
```
let buf=''; es.onmessage=e=>{ buf+=e.data; try{ const o=JSON.parse(buf); handle(o); buf=''; }catch(e){ /* wait for more data */ } }
```

deploy-bot: Canary queued for sse-heartbeat=8s (canary hosts: 3).

Liam (AE): i'll send the customer a short note: ask Skylark admin to bump timeout and test bypass, include SDK snippet and offer Dedicated as an option to remove the corporate gateway.

Jacob (platform): leaving open until canary finishes. last related event 2025234618, no repeats since canary queued.

Liam (AE): thanks team — will update when customer confirms. :thumbsup:
